data.name: caption_text

data.value: Load example configurations to try everything hands-on. Pick the disciplines you work with.

data.name: contents_text
data.value: Each discipline adds collision rules and a project parameter rule based on the ADSK shared parameters. The element checks are installed in any case.

data.name: adskChecksHeader_text
data.value: Project parameter checks and fill checks from the ADSK templates

data.name: adskChecksIntro_text
data.value: Adds checks that compare the project parameters of a document with the ADSK templates and checks that their text parameters are filled. Pick your disciplines: the checks are installed into the same example file.

data.name: target_format
data.value: The example is always written to the "examples" subfolder in {0}. An identical example file is left untouched; a different or edited one is saved as a .bak-<timestamp> copy before the shipped example replaces it.

data.name: installed_format

data.name: unchanged_format
data.value: The example configuration in {0} is already up to date; nothing was changed.

data.name: updated_format
data.value: The example configuration in {0} was updated. The previous file is kept as {1}.
